questions.text: ऐल्फा लिमिटेड ने ₹ 10 प्रत्येक के 50,000 समता अंशों/शेयरों को ₹110 प्रति अंश/शेयर पर जनता को अभिदान के लिए प्रस्तुत किए । समस्त राशि आवेदन पर देय थी। 48,000 अंशों/शेयरों के लिए आवेदन प्राप्त हुए तथा सभी आवेदकों को आबंटन कर दिया गया । आवेदन पर प्राप्त राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: Alfa Ltd. offered for public subscription 50,000 equity shares of ₹10 each at ₹110 per share. The entire amount was payable on application. Applications were received for 48,000 shares and allotment was made to all the applicants. The amount received on application will be :
questions.solution: The total amount received on application is calculated by multiplying the number of shares applied for by the issue price per share. Since 48,000 shares were applied for and the entire issue price of one hundred ten rupees per share was payable on application, the total amount received is fifty-two lakh eighty thousand rupees.
questions.solution_hindi: आवेदन पर प्राप्त कुल राशि की गणना आवेदित अंशों की संख्या को प्रति अंश निर्गम मूल्य से गुणा करके की जाती है। चूँकि 48,000 अंशों के लिए आवेदन प्राप्त हुए और 110 रुपये प्रति अंश की पूरी राशि आवेदन पर देय थी, इसलिए प्राप्त कुल राशि 52,80,000 रुपये होगी।

questions.text: लेक्सा लिमिटेड ने₹ 10 प्रत्येक के 50,000 समता अंशों / शेयरों को ₹2 प्रति अंश/शेयर प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित किया । राशि का भुगतान निम्न प्रकार से देय था : आवेदन एवं आबंटन पर ₹7 प्रति अंश/शेयर (प्रीमियम सहित), प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना पर शेष। निर्गम पूर्ण रूप से अभिदत्त हुआ । 1,000 समता अंशों/शेयरों पर प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना को छोड़कर सभी राशि विधिवत् प्राप्त हो गई। इन अंशों / शेयरों का हरण (forfeit) कर लिया गया । इन अंशों/शेयरों के हरण (forfeit) पर अदत्त याचना खाते में लिखे जाएँगे :
questions.text_english: Lexa Ltd. issued 50,000 equity shares of ₹ 10 each at a premium of ₹ 2 per share. The amount was payable as follows: On application and allotment ₹ 7 per share (including premium), On first and final call Balance. The issue was fully subscribed. All the money was duly received except the first and final call on 1,000 equity shares. These shares were forfeited. On forfeiture of these shares Calls in Arrears Account will be :
questions.solution: The total issue price is twelve rupees per share. Since seven rupees was payable on application and allotment, the remaining balance for the first and final call is five rupees per share. The unpaid amount on one thousand shares is therefore five thousand rupees. Upon forfeiture, the Calls in Arrears account is credited by this exact unpaid amount to close its outstanding debit balance.
questions.solution_hindi: कुल निर्गम मूल्य 12 रुपये है। आवेदन और आवंटन पर 7 रुपये देय थे, इसलिए प्रथम और अंतिम याचना के लिए 5 रुपये शेष बचते हैं। 1,000 अंशों पर अदत्त राशि 5,000 रुपये है। अंशों के हरण पर, इस अदत्त राशि से अदत्त याचना खाते को जमा (क्रेडिट) किया जाएगा।

sub_questions.text_english: KLB Ltd. forfeited 3,000 shares of ₹ 10 each, ₹ 8 per share called up for non-payment of first call of ₹ 2 per share. All these shares were reissued at ₹ 7 per share, ₹ 8 paid up. The amount transferred to Capital Reserve Account will be :
sub_questions.solution: The forfeited amount per share is the called-up value of eight rupees minus the unpaid two rupees, which equals six rupees. During reissue, the discount allowed per share is one rupee. Thus, the net gain per share transferred to the Capital Reserve is five rupees. For three thousand shares, the total transferred amount is fifteen thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: एनयूके लिमिटेड ने ₹ 10 प्रत्येक के 1000 अंशों/शेयरों को, जिन पर पूर्ण राशि माँग ली गई थी, ₹ 2 प्रति अंश/शेयर की अंतिम याचना राशि का भुगतान न करने पर, हरण कर लिया । इनमें से 800 अंशों/शेयरों को ₹11 प्रति अंश पूर्ण प्रदत्त पुनः निर्गमित कर दिया गया। पूँजी संचय खाते में जमा होने वाली राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: NUK Ltd. forfeited 1,000 shares of ₹ 10 each, fully called up for non-payment of final call of ₹ 2 per share. 800 of these shares were reissued at ₹ 11 per share fully paid. The amount credited to Capital Reserve Account will be :
sub_questions.solution: The forfeited amount per share is the fully called-up ten rupees minus the unpaid two rupees, equaling eight rupees. Since the shares were reissued at a premium of one rupee, no discount was utilized. Therefore, the entire forfeited amount of eight rupees per share for the eight hundred reissued shares, which totals six thousand four hundred rupees, is credited to the Capital Reserve.

questions.solution: The question presents two internal choices focusing on the calculation of the amount to be transferred to the Capital Reserve upon the reissue of forfeited shares. You must calculate the net gain per reissued share by subtracting the reissue discount from the forfeited amount and multiplying by the number of shares reissued.

questions.text: ऐसे ऋणपत्र जो ब्याज की कोई विशिष्ट दर वहन नहीं करते हैं, कहलाते हैं :
questions.text_english: The debentures which do not carry a specific rate of interest are called:
questions.solution: Zero Coupon Rate Debentures are unique because they do not carry any explicitly stated specific rate of interest. Instead, investors earn a return because these debentures are issued at a substantial discount to their nominal value and are subsequently redeemed at par.
questions.solution_hindi: शून्य कूपन दर ऋणपत्र ब्याज की कोई विशिष्ट दर वहन नहीं करते हैं। इन ऋणपत्रों को उनके अंकित मूल्य से भारी छूट पर जारी किया जाता है और सममूल्य पर मोचित किया जाता है, जो निवेशक के लिए प्रतिफल का काम करता है।

questions.text: भारतीय प्रतिभूति एवं विनिमय बोर्ड (सेबी) के दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार अंशों/शेयरों के आबंटन के लिए न्यूनतम अभिदान निम्न में से किस पूँजी के 90% से कम नहीं हो सकता ?
questions.text_english: Minimum subscription for allotment of shares as per Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) guidelines cannot be less than 90% of which of the following capital?
questions.solution: According to the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) guidelines, the minimum subscription required for a company to validly proceed with the allotment of shares must not be less than ninety percent of the total issued capital.
questions.solution_hindi: सेबी (SEBI) के दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार, अंशों के आवंटन के लिए न्यूनतम अभिदान निर्गमित पूँजी के 90% से कम नहीं हो सकता है। यदि यह शर्त पूरी नहीं होती है, तो कंपनी को प्राप्त राशि वापस करनी पड़ती है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): जब अंशों / शेयरों का हरण (forfeit) किया जाता है, तो अंश/शेयर पूँजी खाते के नाम में माँगी गई राशि तथा जमा में (i) सम्बन्धित अदत्त याचना खाता अर्थात् अदत्त याचना तथा (ii) अंश/शेयर हरण (forfeit) खाते में अंशों/शेयरों पर पहले से ही प्राप्त राशि होती है।
कारण (R) : जब अंशों/शेयरों का हरण (forfeit) किया जाता है, तब केवल प्रतिभूति प्रीमियम से सम्बन्धित प्रविष्टियों को छोड़कर अंश/शेयर हरण (forfeit) खाते से सम्बन्धित सभी प्रविष्टियों को जिनका लेखा, लेखांकन पुस्तकों में कर दिया गया है, उलट दिया जाता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): When the shares are forfeited, share capital account is debited with the amount called up and credited to (i) respective unpaid calls account i.e., calls in arrears and (ii) share forfeiture account with the amount already received on shares.
Reason (R): When the shares are forfeited, all entries relating to the shares forfeited, except those relating to securities premium, already recorded in accounting records must be reversed.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) incorrect.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason are correct statements. The forfeiture of shares inherently involves canceling the accounting entries made up to the stage of default. Consequently, the share capital is reduced by the called-up amount, and the amount already received is transferred to the share forfeiture account, which makes the reason the correct explanation for the assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सही हैं। अंशों के हरण का अर्थ है चूक के स्तर तक की गई प्रविष्टियों को उलटना। अतः शेयर पूँजी को कम कर दिया जाता है और जो राशि पहले ही प्राप्त हो चुकी है उसे शेयर हरण खाते में जमा कर दिया जाता है, जो कि अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या है।

शीना के आहरण पर ब्याज होगा :
questions.text_english:
Read the following hypothetical situation and answer questions No. 7 and 8 on the basis of the given information:
Richa, Sheena and Tapti were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:1. The partnership deed provided for charging interest on drawings @ 10% p.a. The drawings of Richa, Sheena and Tapti during the year ended 31st March, 2023 amounted to ₹ 50,000, ₹ 40,000 and ₹ 30,000 respectively. The net profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 was ₹ 57,000.
Sheena's interest on drawings will be :
questions.solution: When the specific dates of drawings are not provided in the question, interest is calculated for an average period of six months. Sheena's total drawings are forty thousand rupees. Ten percent of this amount is four thousand, and for six months, it calculates to two thousand rupees.

Tapti's share of profit will be :
questions.solution: First, calculate the total interest on drawings for all partners for six months, which is ten percent of one lakh twenty thousand, equaling six thousand rupees. Tapti's share is one-sixth of this divisible profit, which amounts to ten thousand five hundred rupees.

sub_questions.text_english: Hema and Tara were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:3. They admitted Ojas as a new partner. Hema surrendered 1/3rd of her share and Tara surrendered 1/2 of her share in favour of Ojas. The new profit sharing ratio of Hema, Tara and Ojas will be:
sub_questions.solution: Hema surrenders one-third of her two-fifths share, which equals two-fifteenths, leaving her with four-fifteenths or eight-thirtieths. Tara surrenders half of her three-fifths share, which is three-tenths, leaving her with three-tenths or nine-thirtieths. Ojas's new share is the sum of these surrendered fractions, which equals thirteen-thirtieths. The new profit-sharing ratio is therefore eight to nine to thirteen.

sub_questions.text: आरोह, भुवन तथा चारु एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 1:2:6 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । चारु की मृत्यु हो गई । आरोह तथा भुवन ने चारु के भाग को 2:1 के अनुपात में अधिग्रहित किया । चारु की मृत्यु के बाद आरोह तथा भुवन के बीच नया लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Aaroh, Bhuvan and Charu were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 1:2:6. Charu died. Aaroh and Bhuvan acquired Charu's share in the ratio of 2:1. The new profit sharing ratio between Aaroh and Bhuvan after Charu's death will be:
sub_questions.solution: Charu's share of six-ninths is acquired by Aaroh and Bhuvan in a two-to-one ratio. Aaroh gains two-thirds of six-ninths, which is four-ninths, making his new share five-ninths. Bhuvan gains one-third of six-ninths, which is two-ninths, making his new share four-ninths. The new ratio between Aaroh and Bhuvan is five to four.

sub_questions.text: श्रीकांत तथा अजय एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 5:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में श्रीकांत ने प्रत्येक तिमाही के प्रारम्भ में ₹10,000 का आहरण किया । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में 6% वार्षिक दर से श्रीकांत के आहरण पर ब्याज होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Shrikant and Ajay were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3. Shrikant withdrew ₹10,000 in the beginning of each quarter during the year ended 31st March, 2023. Interest on Shrikant's drawings @ 6% p.a for the year ended 31st March, 2023 will be :
sub_questions.solution: Shrikant's total drawings for the year amount to forty thousand rupees. Since he withdrew the amount at the beginning of each quarter, the average period for interest calculation is seven and a half months. Six percent of forty thousand for this period equals one thousand five hundred rupees.

sub_questions.text: आभा, मंजू एवं रिया एक फर्म में साझेदार थीं तथा 3:3:4 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करती थीं । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के दौरान रिया ने प्रत्येक अर्ध वर्ष के प्रारंभ में ₹ 30,000 का आहरण किया । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में 10% वार्षिक दर से रिया के आहरण पर ब्याज होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Abha, Manju and Rhea were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:3:4. During the year ended 31st March, 2023, Rhea withdrew ₹ 30,000 at the beginning of each half year. Interest on Rhea's drawings @ 10% p.a. for the year ended 31st March, 2023 will be :
sub_questions.solution: Rhea's total drawings for the year amount to sixty thousand rupees. Withdrawing at the beginning of each half-year yields an average period of nine months. Ten percent interest on sixty thousand rupees for nine months calculates to four thousand five hundred rupees.

sub_questions.text: निक्कू, माला तथा रितु एक फर्म में साझेदार थीं तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभों का विभाजन करती थीं। 30 सितम्बर, 2023 को निक्कू की मृत्यु हो गई । मृतक साझेदार मृत्यु की तिथि तक अपने लाभ के भाग का अधिकारी है जिसकी गणना पिछले वर्ष के लाभ के आधार पर की जाएगी। पिछले वर्ष का लाभ ₹ 80,000 था । निक्कू का लाभ में भाग होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Nicku, Mala and Ritu were partners in a firm sharing profits in the ratio of 5:3:2. Nicku died on 30th September, 2023. The deceased partner was entitled to his share of profit up to the date of death which was to be calculated on the basis of previous year's profit. The previous year's profit was ₹ 80,000. Nicku's share of profit will be:
sub_questions.solution: Nicku died on the 30th of September, surviving for exactly six months of the current accounting year. Her share of profit is calculated as the previous year's profit of eighty thousand rupees, multiplied by her share fraction of five-tenths, multiplied by the time proportion of six-twelfths. This calculation yields twenty thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: निखिल, अरुण तथा मानसी एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 4:3:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से उन्होंने निर्णय लिया कि लाभ-हानि का विभाजन 5:3:2 के अनुपात में होगा । लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन के कारण मानसी का अधिलाभ या त्याग होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Nikhil, Arun and Mansi were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:3. With effect from 1st April, 2023, they decided to share profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3:2. Due to change in the profit sharing ratio, Mansi's gain or sacrifice will be:
sub_questions.solution: Mansi's old profit-sharing ratio was three-tenths. Her new profit-sharing ratio is two-tenths. Subtracting the new ratio from the old ratio leaves a positive one-tenth, indicating that she has sacrificed a one-tenth share of the profits.

sub_questions.text: लता, मेहू तथा नमिता एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2023 को उन्होंने फर्म के विघटन का निर्णय लिया । लेनदारों ने अपनी राशि ₹90,000 के आंशिक निपटान में ₹ 80,000 के पुस्तक मूल्य के स्टॉक को 80% पर ले लिया। लेनदारों को शेष राशि का भुगतान चैक द्वारा किया गया। लेनदारों को चैक द्वारा भुगतान की गई राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: Lata, Mehu and Namita were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:1. They decided to dissolve the firm on 31st March, 2023. Creditors took over stock of book value of ₹ 80,000 at 80%, in part settlement of their amount of ₹ 90,000. The balance amount was paid to the creditors by cheque. The amount paid by cheque to the creditors will be:
sub_questions.solution: The creditors accepted stock valued at eighty percent of its book value of eighty thousand rupees, which equates to a settlement of sixty-four thousand rupees. Subtracting this from their total claim of ninety thousand rupees leaves a balance of twenty-six thousand rupees to be paid by cheque.

sub_questions.text: सान्या, सार्थक तथा नित्या एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 4:3:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे। 31 मार्च, 2023 को उन्होंने फर्म के विघटन का निर्णय लिया । इस तिथि को फर्म के पास ₹ 3,00,000 की राशि के देनदार थे तथा ₹ 30,000 का संदिग्ध ऋणों के लिए प्रावधान था । विघटन पर ₹ 20,000 के देनदार डूब गए तथा शेष देनदारों से 90% की वसूली हुई । देनदारों से वसूल की गई राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: Sanya, Sarthak and Nitya were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:1. They decided to dissolve the firm on 31st March, 2023. On this date, the firm had debtors amounting to ₹ 3,00,000 and provision for doubtful debts of ₹ 30,000. On dissolution, debtors for ₹ 20,000 proved bad and the remaining debtors realised 90%. Amount realised from the debtors will be :
sub_questions.solution: The total gross debtors amounted to three lakh rupees. After deducting twenty thousand for bad debts, the remaining good debtors total two lakh eighty thousand rupees. Ninety percent of this remaining amount was realized, which equals two lakh fifty-two thousand rupees.

questions.text: सीमा तथा लक्ष एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । उनकी पूँजी क्रमशः ₹ 2,00,000 तथा ₹ 1,80,000 थी। 1 अप्रैल, 2023 को उन्होंने भावी लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए आदी को एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया । आदी अपनी पूँजी के भाग के रूप में ₹ 1,50,000 लाया । आदी के प्रवेश पर फर्म की ख्याति होगी :
questions.text_english: Seema and Laksh were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:1. Their capitals were ₹ 2,00,000 and ₹ 1,80,000 respectively. They admitted Aadi as a new partner on 1st April, 2023 for 1/5th share in future profits. Aadi brought ₹ 1,50,000 as his share of capital. The goodwill of the firm on Aadi's admission will be :
questions.solution: The total capital of the newly constituted firm based on Aadi's contribution is calculated by multiplying his capital of one lakh fifty thousand by the reciprocal of his share, yielding seven lakh fifty thousand rupees. The combined actual capital of all three partners is five lakh thirty thousand rupees. The difference represents the firm's hidden goodwill, which is two lakh twenty thousand rupees.
questions.solution_hindi: आदी की पूँजी के आधार पर फर्म की कुल पूँजी 7,50,000 रुपये होनी चाहिए। तीनों साझेदारों की वास्तविक पूँजी का योग 5,30,000 रुपये है। अतः फर्म की छिपी हुई ख्याति 2,20,000 रुपये होगी।

questions.text: गीता तथा हरी एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । कृष को फर्म के लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया गया जो उसने गीता तथा हरी से 2:3 के अनुपात में अधिग्रहित किया । कृष अपनी पूँजी के भाग के रूप में ₹ 1,00,000 तथा ख्याति प्रीमियम के रूप में ₹ 50,000 नगद लाया। गीता तथा हरी का त्याग अनुपात होगा :
questions.text_english: Geeta and Hari were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. Krish was admitted as a new partner for 1/5th share in profits of the firm which he acquired from Geeta and Hari in the ratio of 2:3. Krish brought ₹ 1,00,000 as his share of capital and ₹ 50,000 as premium for goodwill in cash. The sacrificing ratio of Geeta and Hari will be:
questions.solution: The problem states that the incoming partner acquired his share from the old partners in a specific ratio of two to three. By definition, the ratio in which the new partner acquires his share from the existing partners is exactly the sacrificing ratio. Therefore, the sacrificing ratio is two to three.
questions.solution_hindi: प्रश्न में स्पष्ट दिया गया है कि नए साझेदार ने अपना हिस्सा पुराने साझेदारों से 2:3 के अनुपात में अधिग्रहित किया है। अधिग्रहण का यह अनुपात ही साझेदारों का त्याग अनुपात होता है। इसलिए, त्याग अनुपात 2:3 होगा।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): 'स्थायी पूँजी विधि' में साझेदारों के चालू खाते बनाए जाते हैं जो नाम शेष भी दर्शा सकते हैं और जमा शेष भी ।
कारण (R) : 'स्थायी पूँजी विधि' में सभी मदों जैसे लाभ या हानि का भाग, पूँजी पर ब्याज, आहरण, आहरण पर ब्याज आदि का लेखा साझेदारों के पूँजी खातों में किया जाता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Partners' current accounts maintained under 'Fixed Capital Method' may show a debit or a credit balance.
Reason (R): In the 'Fixed Capital Method', all items like share of profit or loss, interest on capital, drawings, interest on drawings etc. are recorded in the partners' capital accounts.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही नहीं है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों ग़लत हैं ।

options_english.A: Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is not correct.
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are not correct.

questions.solution: The assertion is correct because under the Fixed Capital Method, Current Accounts are maintained, which can indeed show either debit or credit balances based on drawings and profits. The reason is incorrect because, under this method, items like interest on capital and drawings are recorded in the Current Account, not the Capital Account.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन सही है क्योंकि चालू खाते का शेष नाम या जमा कुछ भी हो सकता है। कारण गलत है क्योंकि 'स्थायी पूँजी विधि' में सभी समायोजन (जैसे आहरण, ब्याज आदि) चालू खाते में दर्ज किए जाते हैं, पूँजी खाते में नहीं।

questions.text: मनु, सोनू तथा राहुल एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 4:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से उन्होंने लाभ तथा हानियों को 3:2:1 के अनुपात में बाँटने का निर्णय लिया । उनका स्थिति विवरण ₹ 84,000 का कर्मचारी क्षतिपूर्ति संचय दर्शा रहा था । कर्मचारी क्षतिपूर्ति के लिए ₹ 75,000 के दावे का अनुमान लगाया गया । उपर्युक्त लेनदेन के प्रभाव को प्रदर्शित करने के लिए रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टि होगी :
questions.text_english: Manu, Sonu and Rahul were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:2. With effect from 1st April, 2023, they decided to share profits and losses in the future in the ratio of 3:2:1. Their Balance Sheet showed Workmen Compensation Reserve of ₹ 84,000. The claim on account of Workmen Compensation is estimated at ₹ 75,000. The journal entry to give effect to the above transaction will be :

options.A: Workmen Compensation Reserve A/c Dr 84,000 To Workmen Compensation Claim A/c 75,000 To Manu's Capital A/c 4,000 To Sonu's Capital A/c 3,000 To Rahul's Capital A/c 2,000
options.B: Workmen Compensation Reserve A/c Dr 84,000 To Workmen Compensation Claim A/c 75,000 To Manu's Capital A/c 4,500 To Sonu's Capital A/c 3,000 To Rahul's Capital A/c 1,500
options.C: Manu's Capital A/c Dr 500 To Rahul's Capital A/c 500
options.D: Workmen Compensation Reserve A/c Dr 84,000 To Workmen Compensation Claim A/c 75,000 To Manu's Capital A/c 3,000 To Sonu's Capital A/c 3,000 To Rahul's Capital A/c 3,000

options_english.A: Workmen Compensation Reserve A/c Dr 84,000 To Workmen Compensation Claim A/c 75,000 To Manu's Capital A/c 4,000 To Sonu's Capital A/c 3,000 To Rahul's Capital A/c 2,000
options_english.B: Workmen Compensation Reserve A/c Dr 84,000 To Workmen Compensation Claim A/c 75,000 To Manu's Capital A/c 4,500 To Sonu's Capital A/c 3,000 To Rahul's Capital A/c 1,500
options_english.C: Manu's Capital A/c Dr 500 To Rahul's Capital A/c 500
options_english.D: Workmen Compensation Reserve A/c Dr 84,000 To Workmen Compensation Claim A/c 75,000 To Manu's Capital A/c 3,000 To Sonu's Capital A/c 3,000 To Rahul's Capital A/c 3,000

questions.solution: The Workmen Compensation Reserve is eighty-four thousand rupees, and the estimated claim is seventy-five thousand rupees. The excess reserve of nine thousand rupees must be distributed among the partners in their old profit-sharing ratio of four to three to two. Therefore, Manu receives four thousand, Sonu receives three thousand, and Rahul receives two thousand rupees.
questions.solution_hindi: 84,000 रुपये के संचय में से 75,000 रुपये दावे के लिए रखे जाएंगे। शेष 9,000 रुपये पुराने साझेदारों में उनके पुराने अनुपात (4:3:2) में बांटे जाएंगे, जिससे मनु को 4,000, सोनू को 3,000 और राहुल को 2,000 रुपये मिलेंगे।

questions.text: अलिशा, बॉबी तथा पूजा एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 30 सितम्बर, 2023 को पूजा की मृत्यु हो गयी । मृत्यु की तिथि तक फर्म के लाभों में पूजा के भाग की गणना विक्रय के आधार पर की जाएगी। वर्ष 2022 - 23 के दौरान विक्रय ₹ 30,00,000 था तथा 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से 30 सितम्बर, 2023 तक विक्रय ₹10,00,000 था । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष का लाभ ₹ 3,00,000 था । मृत्यु की तिथि तक लाभ में पूजा के भाग की गणना कीजिए तथा फर्म की पुस्तकों में इसके लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टि कीजिए। अपने कार्य को स्पष्टता से दर्शाइए ।
questions.text_english: Alisha, Bobby and Pooja were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3:2. Pooja died on 30th September, 2023. Pooja's share in the profits of the firm till the date of death was to be calculated on the basis of sales. Sales during the year 2022-23 were ₹ 30,00,000 and sales from 1st April, 2023 to 30th September, 2023 were ₹ 10,00,000. The profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 was ₹ 3,00,000. Calculate Pooja's share of profit up to the date of death and pass the necessary journal entry for the same in the books of the firm. Show your workings clearly.

key_points: Calculate profit percentage based on previous year's sales.
Apply percentage to current period sales to estimate profit.
Calculate Pooja's share of the estimated profit.
Pass journal entry routing through P&L Suspense Account.

questions.solution: First, calculate the profit margin based on the previous year: the profit was three lakh rupees on sales of thirty lakh rupees, establishing a ten percent profit margin. Applying this ten percent margin to the sales of ten lakh rupees achieved from April to September 2023, the estimated firm profit for the period is one lakh rupees. Pooja's specific share is two-tenths of this profit, equaling twenty thousand rupees. Because the continuing partners' ratio does not change, this is recorded by debiting Profit and Loss Suspense Account and crediting Pooja's Capital Account with twenty thousand rupees.

questions.text: एक फर्म का पिछले पाँच वर्षों का औसत लाभ ₹ 20,000 था। इसी प्रकार के व्यवसाय में प्रतिफल की सामान्य दर 8% है। फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन अधिलाभ के तीन वर्षों के क्रय के आधार पर ₹ 24,000 किया गया। फर्म द्वारा विनियोजित पूँजी की राशि की गणना कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: The average profit for the last five years of a firm was ₹ 20,000. The normal rate of return in a similar business is 8%. Goodwill of the firm is valued at ₹ 24,000 at three years' purchase of super profit. Calculate the amount of capital employed by the firm.

key_points: Determine super profit from goodwill valuation.
Determine normal profit by subtracting super profit from average profit.
Calculate capital employed using the normal profit and NRR.

questions.solution: First, calculate the super profit using the given goodwill figure. Since goodwill is twenty-four thousand rupees based on three years' purchase, the super profit is eight thousand rupees. The average profit is given as twenty thousand rupees. By subtracting the super profit from the average profit, the normal profit is identified as twelve thousand rupees. Finally, the capital employed is found by dividing the normal profit by the normal rate of return of eight percent, yielding a total capital employed of one lakh fifty thousand rupees.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक का उत्तर दें:
questions.text_english: Attempt any one of the following:
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से कोई एक प्रश्न हल करें।
questions.instruction_line_english: Attempt any one of the following sub-questions.

sub_questions.text: मिशा तथा प्रिशा एक फर्म में साझेदार थीं तथा 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करती थीं । 1 अप्रैल, 2022 को उनके पूँजी खाते क्रमशः ₹ 50,000 तथा ₹ 30,000 के शेष दर्शा रहे थे। वर्ष के दौरान मिशा ने ₹ 12,900, जबकि प्रिशा ने ₹ 9,600 का आहरण किया। उन्हें 10% वार्षिक दर से पूँजी पर ब्याज अनुमत किया गया था। मिशा के आहरण पर ₹ 660 का ब्याज तथा प्रिशा के आहरण पर ₹ 540 का ब्याज प्रभारित किया गया । 1 अगस्त, 2022 को प्रिशा ने फर्म को ₹ 20,000 का ऋण दिया । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष का शुद्ध लाभ ₹ 22,600 था । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष का लाभ-हानि विनियोग खाता तैयार कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Misha and Prisha were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. On 1st April, 2022, their capital accounts showed balances of ₹ 50,000 and ₹ 30,000 respectively. During the year, Misha withdrew ₹ 12,900 while Prisha withdrew ₹ 9,600. They were allowed interest on capital @ 10% p.a. Interest on drawings of ₹ 660 was charged on Misha's drawings and ₹ 540 on Prisha's drawings. Prisha had advanced a loan of ₹ 20,000 to the firm on 1st August, 2022. The net profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 amounted to ₹ 22,600. Prepare Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for the year ended 31st March, 2023.

key_points: Deduct interest on partner's loan from net profit.
Credit net profit and interest on drawings to Appropriation Account.
Debit interest on capital.
Distribute the divisible profit in the agreed ratio.

sub_questions.solution: Before preparing the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account, interest on Prisha's loan must be deducted from the net profit. Since the loan was advanced on August 1st and no rate is given, six percent per annum is applied for eight months, equating to eight hundred rupees. Deducting this from twenty-two thousand six hundred yields a corrected net profit of twenty-one thousand eight hundred rupees. In the Appropriation Account, credit this profit along with total interest on drawings of one thousand two hundred rupees, making the total credit twenty-three thousand rupees. Debit interest on capital of five thousand for Misha and three thousand for Prisha, totaling eight thousand. The divisible profit of fifteen thousand rupees is then distributed, crediting nine thousand to Misha and six thousand to Prisha.

sub_questions.text: 31 मार्च, 2023 को आहरण व शुद्ध लाभ के सम्बन्ध में सभी आवश्यक समायोजन करने के पश्चात् राघव तथा दिया की पूँजी क्रमशः ₹ 4,00,000 तथा ₹ 3,00,000 थी । बाद में यह ज्ञात हुआ कि 10% वार्षिक दर से पूँजी पर ब्याज नहीं दिया गया । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष का शुद्ध लाभ ₹ 1,00,000 था । 31 मार्च, 2023 वर्ष के दौरान, राघव के आहरण प्रत्येक माह के आरम्भ में ₹ 2,000, जबकि दिया के आहरण प्रत्येक तिमाही के आरम्भ में ₹ 3,000 थे । आवश्यक समायोजन प्रविष्टि कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: On 31st March, 2023, the capitals of Raghav and Diya stood at ₹ 4,00,000 and ₹ 3,00,000 respectively, after the necessary adjustment in respect of drawings and net profit. Subsequently, it was discovered that interest on capital @ 10% p.a had been omitted. The Net Profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 amounted to ₹ 1,00,000. During the year ended 31st March, 2023, Raghav's drawings were ₹ 2,000 drawn at the beginning of each month, while Diya's drawings were ₹ 3,000 drawn at the beginning of each quarter. Pass the necessary adjustment entry.

key_points: Calculate opening capitals by adding drawings and deducting profit.
Calculate interest on opening capital @ 10%.
Compute the net effect of omitting interest and wrongly distributing profits.
Pass a single adjustment journal entry.

sub_questions.solution: First, ascertain the opening capitals. Raghav's drawings were twenty-four thousand and Diya's were twelve thousand. The profit of one lakh was distributed equally (fifty thousand each). Reversing these, Raghav's opening capital is three lakh seventy-four thousand, and Diya's is two lakh sixty-two thousand. Interest on these capitals at ten percent yields thirty-seven thousand four hundred for Raghav and twenty-six thousand two hundred for Diya, totaling sixty-three thousand six hundred rupees. This total interest was wrongly distributed as profit, meaning each partner incorrectly received thirty-one thousand eight hundred rupees. Comparing the correct interest to the wrongly distributed profit, Raghav is short by five thousand six hundred, while Diya has an excess of five thousand six hundred. The adjustment entry debits Diya's Capital Account and credits Raghav's Capital Account with five thousand six hundred rupees.

questions.solution: Attempt either sub-question. The first requires preparing a Profit and Loss Appropriation Account considering a partner's loan, and the second requires calculating opening capitals to pass a past adjustment journal entry for omitted interest.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक का उत्तर दें:
questions.text_english: Attempt any one of the following:
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से कोई एक प्रश्न हल करें।
questions.instruction_line_english: Attempt any one of the following sub-questions.

sub_questions.text: सुमी लिमिटेड ने पंडोरा लिमिटेड से ₹ 8,00,000 की परिसम्पत्तियों तथा ₹2,00,000 के विविध लेनदारों का अधिग्रहण ₹ 9,00,000 के क्रय मूल्य पर किया । भुगतान ₹ 4,60,000 का एक चैक निर्गमित करके तथा शेष के लिए ₹100 प्रत्येक के 9% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 10% प्रीमियम पर करके किया गया । उपर्युक्त लेनदेनों के लिए सुमी लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Sumi Ltd. acquired assets of ₹ 8,00,000 and took over sundry creditors of ₹ 2,00,000 from Pandora Ltd. for a purchase consideration of ₹ 9,00,000. The payment was made by issuing a cheque of ₹ 4,60,000 and remaining by issue of 9% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 10%. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Sumi Ltd.

key_points: Record acquisition showing Goodwill.
Record partial payment by bank.
Record issue of debentures at a premium.

sub_questions.solution: In the books of Sumi Ltd, record the acquisition by debiting Sundry Assets with eight lakh rupees and Goodwill Account as a balancing figure with three lakh rupees. Credit Sundry Creditors with two lakh rupees and Pandora Ltd with the purchase consideration of nine lakh rupees. To record the settlement, first debit Pandora Ltd and credit Bank Account with four lakh sixty thousand rupees for the cheque payment. The remaining balance of four lakh forty thousand rupees is settled by issuing four thousand debentures at a premium. Record this by debiting Pandora Ltd with four lakh forty thousand rupees, crediting nine percent Debentures Account with the nominal value of four lakh rupees, and crediting Securities Premium Reserve with forty thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: गुंडोला लिमिटेड ने एके लिमिटेड से ₹ 9,00,000 की परिसम्पत्तियों तथा ₹ 3,00,000 की देयताओं का अधिग्रहण ₹ 14,00,000 के सहमत क्रय मूल्य पर किया । भुगतान ₹ 5,00,000 के एक बैंक ड्राफ्ट द्वारा तथा शेष के लिए 10% की छूट पर 8% ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन द्वारा किया गया । उपर्युक्त लेनदेन के लिए गुंडोला लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Gundola Ltd. took over assets of ₹ 9,00,000 and liabilities of ₹ 3,00,000 from AK Ltd. for an agreed purchase consideration of ₹ 14,00,000. The payment was made through a bank draft of ₹ 5,00,000 and the remaining by issue of 8% Debentures at a discount of 10%. Record necessary journal entries in the books of Gundola Ltd. for the above transactions.

key_points: Record acquisition showing Goodwill.
Record partial payment by bank.
Record issue of debentures at a discount.

sub_questions.solution: In the books of Gundola Ltd, initiate by debiting Sundry Assets with nine lakh rupees and Goodwill Account with eight lakh rupees as the balancing figure representing the excess paid. Credit Sundry Liabilities with three lakh rupees and AK Ltd with fourteen lakh rupees. Next, record the partial payment by debiting AK Ltd and crediting Bank Account with five lakh rupees. The remaining nine lakh rupees are settled through debentures issued at a ten percent discount (issue price ninety rupees), resulting in ten thousand debentures. Conclude by debiting AK Ltd with nine lakh rupees, debiting Discount on Issue of Debentures Account with one lakh rupees, and crediting eight percent Debentures Account with the full nominal value of ten lakh rupees.

questions.solution: Attempt either sub-question. Both sub-questions require journalizing the purchase of a business, identifying goodwill as a balancing figure, and issuing debentures at either a premium or a discount to settle the purchase consideration.

questions.text:
फ्रैंक, जॉर्ज तथा हेमन्त एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभों का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से उन्होंने लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात को 2:5:3 में परिवर्तित करने का निर्णय लिया । 31 मार्च, 2023 को उनका स्थिति विवरण निम्न प्रकार था : यह निर्णय लिया गया कि :
(i) भूमि के मूल्य में वृद्धि हुई और इसे ₹ 6,50,000 तक लाया जाए ।
(ii) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 2,00,000 किया गया। ख्याति को फर्म की पुस्तकों में नहीं दर्शाया जाएगा ।
फर्म की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Frank, George and Hemant were partners in a firm sharing profits in the ratio of 5:3:2. They decided to change their profit sharing ratio to 2:5:3 with effect from 1st April, 2023. Their Balance Sheet as at 31st March, 2023 was as follows:
It was decided that :
(i) The value of land having appreciated be brought up to ₹ 6,50,000.
(ii) Goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 2,00,000. Goodwill was not to appear in the books of the firm.
Pass the necessary journal entries in the books of the firm.

key_points: Record the appreciation of land to the Revaluation Account.
Distribute the revaluation profit to old partners.
Distribute the General Reserve to old partners.
Calculate gaining and sacrificing ratios for Goodwill adjustment.
Pass adjusting journal entry for Goodwill.

questions.solution: First, address the land appreciation by debiting the Land Account and crediting the Revaluation Account with one lakh fifty thousand rupees. Immediately transfer this revaluation profit to the partners by debiting the Revaluation Account and crediting the Capital Accounts of Frank, George, and Hemant with seventy-five thousand, forty-five thousand, and thirty thousand rupees respectively, based on their old five to three to two ratio. Next, distribute the accumulated General Reserve by debiting the General Reserve Account with two lakh rupees and crediting the partners' Capital Accounts in their old ratio, yielding one lakh for Frank, sixty thousand for George, and forty thousand for Hemant. Finally, adjust for goodwill. The change in ratio dictates that Frank sacrifices three-tenths, while George gains two-tenths and Hemant gains one-tenth. To adjust the two lakh rupee goodwill without raising an account, debit George's Capital Account with forty thousand rupees and Hemant's Capital Account with twenty thousand rupees, and credit Frank's Capital Account with the full sacrificed equivalent of sixty thousand rupees.

questions.text:
श्री गंगा लिमिटेड ₹ 10 प्रत्येक के समता अंशों/शेयरों में विभक्त ₹7,00,000 की अधिकृत पूँजी के साथ पंजीकृत थी । इसने जनता को अभिदान के लिए 50,000 समता अंश/शेयर प्रस्तुत किए । राशि का भुगतान निम्न प्रकार से देय था :
आवेदन पर : ₹ 4 प्रति अंश/शेयर
आबंटन पर : ₹ 4 प्रति अंश/शेयर
प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना पर : शेष
निर्गम पूर्ण रूप से अभिदत्त हुआ । 4,000 समता अंशों/शेयरों पर प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना राशि के अतिरिक्त सभी राशियाँ विधिवत् प्राप्त हो गईं ।
कम्पनी अधिनियम, 2013 की अनुसूची III, भाग I के अनुसार कम्पनी के स्थिति विवरण में अंश/शेयर पूँजी को दर्शाइए। इसी के लिए 'खातों के नोट्स' भी तैयार कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Shri Ganga Ltd. was registered with an authorised capital of ₹ 7,00,000 divided into equity shares of ₹ 10 each. It offered to the public for subscription 50,000 equity shares. The amount was payable as follows:
On application : ₹ 4 per share
On allotment : ₹ 4 per share
On first and final call : Balance
The issue was fully subscribed. All the amounts were duly received except the first and final call money on 4,000 equity shares.
Show the Share Capital in the Balance Sheet of the company as per Schedule III, Part I of the Companies Act, 2013. Also prepare 'Notes to Accounts' for the same.

key_points: Format Balance Sheet extract showing Share Capital.
Prepare Notes to Accounts.
Detail Authorised and Issued Capital.
Deduct Calls in Arrears to show Subscribed but not fully paid capital.

questions.solution: In the Balance Sheet extract of Shri Ganga Ltd under 'Equity and Liabilities', the sub-head 'Share Capital' will show a final amount of four lakh ninety-two thousand rupees linked to Note number one. The Notes to Accounts for Share Capital will present the Authorised Capital as seventy thousand equity shares of ten rupees each totaling seven lakh rupees. The Issued Capital is listed as fifty thousand equity shares of ten rupees each totaling five lakh rupees. Under Subscribed Capital, the 'Subscribed and fully paid-up' portion shows forty-six thousand shares at ten rupees each totaling four lakh sixty thousand rupees. The 'Subscribed but not fully paid-up' segment includes four thousand shares at ten rupees each yielding forty thousand rupees, less calls in arrears of eight thousand rupees (four thousand shares failing the two rupee final call), leaving thirty-two thousand rupees. Combining the paid-up portions confirms the final Share Capital figure of four lakh ninety-two thousand rupees.
questions.topic: Presentation of Share Capital in Balance Sheet

questions.text:
रिशान, सुज़ेन तथा ताप्ती एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा लाभ-हानि बराबर-बराबर विभाजित करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2023 को उनका स्थिति विवरण दिया गया है। उपर्युक्त तिथि को निम्नलिखित शर्तों पर फर्म का विघटन हो गया :
(i) संयंत्र एवं उपकरण की वसूली पुस्तक मूल्य से 10% कम पर हुई ।
(ii) देनदार पुस्तक मूल्य पर वसूल हुए ।
(iii) निवेशों को सुज़ेन ₹1,00,000 में ले लिया ।
(iv) ताप्ती ने 50% स्टॉक को ₹36,000 में ले लिया। बाकी स्टॉक को ₹ 19,000 में बेच दिया गया ।
(v) वसूली व्यय ₹ 20,000 थे जिसका भुगतान रिशान द्वारा किया गया ।
वसूली खाता तैयार कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Rishan, Suzane and Tapti were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses equally. On 31st March, 2023 their Balance Sheet contained capitals of Rishan 1,25,000, Suzane 1,05,000, Tapti 55,000. On the above date, the firm was dissolved on the following terms:
(i) Plant and Equipment were realised at 10% less than the book value.
(ii) Debtors were realised at book value.
(iii) Investments were taken over by Suzane at ₹ 1,00,000.
(iv) Tapti took over 50% of the stock at ₹ 36,000. The remaining stock was sold for ₹ 19,000.
(v) Expenses of realisation amounted to ₹ 20,000 which were paid by Rishan.
Prepare Realisation Account.

key_points: Transfer all assets (except bank) to the debit side of Realisation Account.
Transfer external liabilities to the credit side.
Record cash realized from assets and assets taken by partners on the credit side.
Record settlement of liabilities and realization expenses on the debit side.
Calculate and distribute the realization loss.

questions.solution: Begin the Realisation Account by transferring the book values of the specified assets to the debit side: Plant and Equipment at two lakh rupees, Investments at eighty thousand, Stock at sixty thousand, and Debtors at forty thousand, creating a total debit transfer of three lakh eighty thousand rupees. Correspondingly, transfer the Creditors to the credit side at sixty thousand rupees. Next, record the amounts realized. On the credit side, register the bank inflow of one lakh eighty thousand for Plant and Equipment, forty thousand for Debtors, and nineteen thousand for the sold stock, totaling two lakh thirty-nine thousand rupees. Also on the credit side, record Suzane's Capital Account for taking investments at one lakh rupees, and Tapti's Capital Account for taking half the stock at thirty-six thousand rupees. On the debit side, document the payment to Creditors through the Bank Account for their full sixty thousand rupees, and credit Rishan's Capital Account with twenty thousand rupees for settling the realization expenses. The total of the debit side amounts to four lakh sixty thousand rupees, while the credit side (excluding loss) totals four lakh thirty-five thousand rupees. This results in a realization loss of twenty-five thousand rupees, which is equally distributed by debiting the Capital Accounts of Rishan, Suzane, and Tapti with eight thousand three hundred thirty-three rupees (with one receiving an adjusted rounding).

questions.text:
1 अप्रैल, 2022 को बैलफोन्ट लिमिटेड ने ₹ 500 प्रत्येक के 5,000, 7% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 5% प्रीमियम पर किया, जिनका शोधन पाँच वर्ष पश्चात् 10% प्रीमियम पर किया जाएगा । निर्गमन से पूर्व कम्पनी के 'प्रतिभूति प्रीमियम खाते' में ₹ 3,25,000 का शेष था ।
(क) ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन तथा 'ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन पर हानि' को प्रथम वर्ष में ही प्रतिभूति प्रीमियम खाते का उपयोग करते हुए अपलिखित करने के लिए रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
(ख) 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए 'ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन पर हानि खाता' तैयार कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
On 1st April, 2022, Bellfont Ltd. issued 5,000, 7% Debentures of ₹ 500 each at a premium of 5%, redeemable at a premium of 10% after five years. The company had a balance of ₹ 3,25,000 in 'Securities Premium Account' before the issue.
(a) Pass journal entries for issue of debentures and for writing off 'Loss on Issue of Debentures' utilising Securities Premium Account at the end of the first year itself.
(b) Prepare 'Loss on Issue of Debentures Account' for the year ended 31st March, 2023.

sub_questions.text_english:
Sarah and Varsha were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. Their Balance Sheet as at 31st March, 2023 contained Capitals (Sarah 60k, Varsha 50k), Workmen's Comp Fund 20k, Provident Fund 120k. On 1st April, 2023, they decided to admit Tasha as a new partner for 1/4th share in the profits of the firm on the following terms :
(i) Tasha brought ₹ 40,000 as her capital and ₹ 20,000 as her share of premium for goodwill.
(ii) Plant and Machinery was valued at ₹ 1,90,000.
(iii) An item of ₹ 20,000, included in creditors, is not likely to be claimed and should be written off.
(iv) Capitals of the partners in the new firm are to be in the new profit sharing ratio on the basis of Tasha's capital, by bringing or paying off cash, as the case may be.
Prepare Revaluation Account and Partners' Capital Accounts.

key_points: Prepare Revaluation Account and distribute profit/loss.
Distribute Workmen Compensation Fund and Goodwill premium to old partners.
Calculate the new profit sharing ratio and the required new capitals.
Adjust old partners' capitals through cash brought in or paid off.

sub_questions.solution: To prepare the Revaluation Account, debit the ten thousand rupee decrease in Plant and Machinery and credit the twenty thousand rupee write-off in Creditors. This yields a net revaluation profit of ten thousand rupees, credited to Sarah as six thousand and Varsha as four thousand. In the Capital Accounts, start by crediting opening balances of sixty thousand and fifty thousand respectively. Credit the Workmen Compensation Fund of twenty thousand in the old ratio, giving twelve thousand to Sarah and eight thousand to Varsha. Credit Tasha's goodwill premium of twenty thousand in the sacrificing ratio (three to two), giving twelve thousand to Sarah and eight thousand to Varsha. The adjusted capitals become ninety thousand for Sarah and seventy thousand for Varsha. Tasha's capital is forty thousand for a one-fourth share, making the firm's total target capital one lakh sixty thousand rupees. The remaining three-fourths share is divided between Sarah and Varsha in their original ratio, resulting in a new firm ratio of nine to six to five. Consequently, Sarah's required capital is seventy-two thousand and Varsha's is forty-eight thousand. Because their adjusted capitals exceed these targets, Sarah will be paid eighteen thousand rupees and Varsha will be paid twenty-two thousand rupees, balancing the final Capital Accounts to exactly match the target ratios.

(i) ₹ 5,000 के डूबत ऋणों को अपलिखित किया जाएगा ।
(ii) स्थायी परिसम्पत्तियों का पुनर्मूल्यांकन ₹ 96,000 किया गया ।
(iii) स्टॉक का मूल्यांकन ₹ 29,000 कम किया गया ।
(iv) लेनदारों का भुगतान कर दिया गया ।
(v) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹80,000 किया गया तथा ख्याति में कपिल के भाग का समायोजन इन्दर तथा जॉनी के खातों में किया गया ।
(vi) इन्दर और जॉनी का नया लाभ विभाजन अनुपात 3:2 था ।
कपिल की सेवानिवृत्ति पर फर्म की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english:
Inder, Jonny and Kapil were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 9:3:4. Their Balance Sheet as at 31st March, 2023 contained a General Reserve of 80,000. Kapil retired from the firm on 31st March, 2023 on the following terms:
(i) Bad Debts amounting to ₹ 5,000 were to be written off.
(ii) Fixed Assets were revalued at ₹ 96,000.
(iii) Stock was undervalued by ₹ 29,000.
(iv) Creditors were paid off.
(v) Goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 80,000 and Kapil's share of goodwill was to be adjusted in the accounts of Inder and Jonny.
(vi) New profit sharing ratio between Inder and Jonny was 3: 2.
Pass the necessary journal entries in the books of the firm on Kapil's retirement.

key_points: Record asset revaluations and distribute revaluation balance.
Distribute the General Reserve among all partners.
Record the payment to creditors.
Calculate gaining ratio and adjust the retiring partner's goodwill.
Transfer retiring partner's dues to his loan account.

sub_questions.solution: Begin by addressing revaluations: debit Revaluation Account and credit Debtors with five thousand rupees for bad debts; debit Revaluation Account and credit Fixed Assets with twenty-four thousand rupees to reflect its decline to ninety-six thousand. Conversely, debit Stock and credit Revaluation Account with twenty-nine thousand rupees to correct the undervaluation. Since total debits match total credits, the revaluation profit is zero, requiring no distribution entry. Distribute the eighty thousand rupee General Reserve by debiting it fully and crediting Inder, Jonny, and Kapil with forty-five thousand, fifteen thousand, and twenty thousand rupees respectively, based on their nine to three to four ratio. Pay off the creditors by debiting Creditors and crediting Bank Account with ten thousand rupees. To adjust goodwill, determine Kapil's share, which is four-sixteenths of eighty thousand, equating to twenty thousand rupees. The gaining ratio is calculated as three to seventeen between Inder and Jonny. Debit Inder's Capital Account with three thousand rupees, debit Jonny's Capital Account with seventeen thousand rupees, and credit Kapil's Capital Account with twenty thousand rupees. Finally, calculate Kapil's total due by adding his opening capital of sixty thousand, his reserve share of twenty thousand, and his goodwill share of twenty thousand, and pass an entry debiting his Capital Account and crediting Kapil's Loan Account with one lakh rupees.

questions.solution: Select one scenario. For admission, systematically draft the Revaluation and Capital Accounts including meticulous proportionate capital computations based on the incoming partner's share. For retirement, sequentially log journal entries managing asset revaluations, reserve distributions, specific gaining ratio goodwill adjustments, and concluding loan transfers.

अंशों/शेयरों के हरण (forfeit) तथा पुनर्निर्गमन के लिए निम्नलिखित स्थितियों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए :

sub_questions.text_english:
Pass necessary journal entries for forfeiture and reissue of shares in the following cases:
(i) Neon Ltd. forfeited 2,000 shares of ₹ 10 each issued at a premium of ₹ 2 per share for non-payment of allotment money of ₹ 5 per share (including premium). The first and final call of ₹ 2 per share was not yet made. Out of these, 1,500 shares were reissued at ₹ 7 per share, ₹ 8 paid up.
(ii) Mamta Ltd. forfeited 3,000 shares of ₹ 10 each on which the first call of ₹ 3 per share was not received. The second and final call of ₹ 1 per share was not yet called. Out of these, 2,000 shares were reissued at ₹ 9 per share, ₹ 9 paid up.

key_points: Record forfeiture considering the called-up capital and unpaid premiums.
Record reissue incorporating discounts allowed.
Transfer proportionate gain to Capital Reserve.

sub_questions.solution: For Neon Ltd, the called-up value is eight rupees per share. Debit Share Capital with sixteen thousand rupees and Securities Premium Reserve with four thousand rupees (since premium on allotment was unpaid). Credit Share Allotment with ten thousand rupees and Share Forfeiture with ten thousand rupees. Upon reissuing 1,500 shares at seven rupees, debit Bank with ten thousand five hundred rupees, debit Share Forfeiture with one thousand five hundred rupees (discount), and credit Share Capital with twelve thousand rupees. The gain per share is four rupees (five received minus one discount), so transfer six thousand rupees to Capital Reserve. For Mamta Ltd, the called-up value is nine rupees. Debit Share Capital with twenty-seven thousand rupees, credit Share First Call with nine thousand, and credit Share Forfeiture with eighteen thousand rupees. Reissuing 2,000 shares at nine rupees fully covers the paid-up status without discount. Debit Bank with eighteen thousand rupees and credit Share Capital with eighteen thousand. The entire forfeited amount for those 2,000 shares, which is twelve thousand rupees, is transferred directly to Capital Reserve.

Sai Ltd. invited applications for issuing 60,000 shares of ₹ 10 each. The amount was payable as follows:
On application ₹ 5 per share
On allotment ₹ 1 per share
On first and final call Balance
Applications were received for 58,000 shares. Rajat, the holder of 300 shares, did not pay allotment money and Usha, the holder of 500 shares, paid her entire share money along with allotment money. Rajat's shares were forfeited immediately after allotment. First and final call was made afterwards and duly received. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions. Open 'Calls-in-arrears' and 'Calls-in-advance' Account, wherever required.

key_points: Record application money received for 58,000 shares.
Record allotment due and receipt with arrears and advance.
Forfeit the defaulting shares before making the call.
Make the final call on the remaining shares.
Record receipt of final call adjusting the advance.

sub_questions.solution: Begin by debiting Bank and crediting Share Application with two lakh ninety thousand rupees for 58,000 shares. Transfer this to Share Capital. Record the allotment due by debiting Share Allotment and crediting Share Capital with fifty-eight thousand rupees. During receipt, Rajat defaults on 300 shares (arrears of three hundred rupees), while Usha pays an advance of two thousand rupees on her 500 shares for the final call. Debit Bank with fifty-nine thousand seven hundred rupees, debit Calls in Arrears with three hundred, credit Share Allotment with fifty-eight thousand, and credit Calls in Advance with two thousand. Immediately forfeit Rajat's shares by debiting Share Capital with eighteen hundred rupees (six rupees called up), crediting Calls in Arrears with three hundred, and crediting Share Forfeiture with fifteen hundred rupees. Proceed to make the final call of four rupees on the remaining 57,700 shares. Debit Share First and Final Call and credit Share Capital with two lakh thirty-eight hundred rupees. Finally, record receipt by debiting Bank with two lakh twenty-eight thousand eight hundred rupees, debiting Calls in Advance with two thousand rupees, and crediting Share First and Final Call with two lakh thirty-eight hundred rupees.
